dialogues.speaker: Rameo
dialogues.text: I thank thee, kind stranger. Most horrid these hilichurls are, assaulting my... friend and myself as we were traveling the road. Still, it is good that she is well.

dialogues.speaker: Rameo
dialogues.text: It is well that she is safe... No, she must be much afear'd for mine safety, or I am a fool! I must go to her, post-haste! Again, you have my thanks.
